import numpy as np
A=np.array(grid)
# key region excludes rows 7..11 cols 2..3 (zero indexed)
exclude={(r,c) for r in range(7,12) for c in range(2,4)}
for src,dst in [(3,4),(6,8),(8,2),(2,4)]:
    coords=[(r,c) for r in range(13) for c in range(19) if A[r,c]==src and (r,c) not in exclude]
    if not coords: continue
    r0=min(r for r,c in coords); r1=max(r for r,c in coords); c0=min(c for r,c in coords); c1=max(c for r,c in coords)
    # fill only original background cells
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
      for c in range(c0,c1+1):
        if A[r,c]==1: A[r,c]=dst
    # if entire bbox occupied by source (solid object), recolor as in demo 4
    if all(grid[r][c]==src for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1)):
      A[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]=dst
    print(src,dst,(r0,r1,c0,c1))
